scripts.build: npm run sidecar -- -c release && electron-vite build && electron-builder && npm run sign
scripts.reset-permissions: tccutil reset Microphone uk.co.owenprice.voicer; tccutil reset SpeechRecognition uk.co.owenprice.voicer
scripts.reset-permissions-all: npm run reset-permissions; tccutil reset ScreenCapture uk.co.owenprice.voicer; tccutil reset Accessibility uk.co.owenprice.voicer
scripts.dist: npm run build && rm -f dist/Voicer-macOS.zip && ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent dist/mac/Voicer.app dist/Voicer-macOS.zip

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voicer listens when you press its microphone button.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Voicer transcribes your speech on this Mac, without sending audio anywhere.
